summary: Two independent causes: smoke adds a competing V2 host.status presentation read, while the ordinary no-project Header reports project-event subscription state as Host health. No evidence that Main Proxy spontaneously changes authority generation.

smoke_result.observed: READY/UP and completed native_probe; shutdown_confirmed report. Original SMOKE-RESULT outer_job_stop_proved remains false; Root separately reports final Job stop proof, not reverified here.

findings.mechanism: NativeProjectEntry effect calls renderer V2 host.status once. After React loads, SMOKE also calls the exact renderer V2 host.status. Both are presentationRead for the same sessionState WeakMap and method ticket; issuing read2 invalidates read1, regardless of completion order. This can produce screenshot entry STALE while later smoke probe completes. Neither selectionGeneration nor authorityGeneration need change.
findings.certainty: Mechanism and exact five-case pure reproduction verified. Screenshot request timings were not instrumented, so precise historical ordering is inferred from source and screenshot, not invented as a raw trace.
findings.normal_fresh_start: Current homepage has one NativeProjectEntry mount read and no StrictMode. Project list is separate API listProjects, not V2 host.status. Parent refresh/list state only rerenders; no mount rerun. Hence normal fresh startup is not proven to intrinsically produce STALE; adding another independent same-method reader can produce it with no smoke flag.
findings.minimum_fix: Change only privileged Main smoke diagnostic to use existing Main-only authority-read lane ipc.callV2(v2Deps, host.status, {}, ipc.AUTHORITY_READ), or run its sole probe before React mounts. Keep AUTHORITY_READ private and preserve its host/context/write/barrier checks. Do not invoke a competing renderer presentation read from smoke. No renderer body flag may select this lane.
not_a_fix: Retry failed mutations, allocate new command IDs, or re-send writes automatically
Change wording to hide lost first-entry response
Add another independent host.status poll in Header without read sharing

findings.mechanism: useProjectEvents initializes online=false and returns without a subscription when projectId is absent. Header and sidebar map that boolean directly to connected/disconnected. A healthy Core with no selected project therefore appears disconnected in ordinary fresh startup, independently of smoke.
findings.minimum_fix: Introduce/shared actual project-independent Host connection state (checking/healthy/unavailable/error + last verified time). Use the existing statusHealth preload read for Native Desktop, or a single shared host.status result rather than a competing read. Supply it to Header/sidebar. Keep project event-stream syncing/offline as a distinct project-scoped status and preserve write guards based on actual authority/currentness.
findings.existing_bridge: apps/desktop/preload/preload.js:11 statusHealth flat bridge -> ipc.callCore -> GET /healthz; no new credential or renderer authority field required. Treat actual failure as unavailable, not green. Project event availability never establishes Host health or vice versa.
